# CLI Checklist: WARP Registration & Endpoint Scan

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the new CLI surface, report schemas, and profile formats
**Created**: 2026-09-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK071 Are `register` command requirements defined (flags, defaults, outputs, exits)? [Completeness, contracts/cli.md]
- [ ] CHK072 Are `renew` command requirements defined, including `--masque-only` scope? [Completeness, contracts/cli.md]
- [ ] CHK073 Are RegistrationReport action-enum requirements complete (is every outcome in the enum reachable)? [Completeness, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK074 Are `warp.toml` shape-error requirements defined (fail-closed behavior per field)? [Completeness, contracts/profiles.md]
- [ ] CHK075 Are connect-path reporting requirements defined (does an inline auto-registration emit a RegistrationReport)? [Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK076 Are exit codes specified per register/renew outcome (which action maps to which exit)? [Clarity, contracts/cli.md]
- [ ] CHK077 Is "blocked vs refused distinguished" specified as distinct report values AND distinct exits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK078 Is non-TTY behavior specified for the license prompt path (no TTY, no flag, no file)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK079 Is `--masque-only` in contracts/cli.md backed by a spec requirement, or is it contract-only scope? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK080 Is the `--provider` override in quickstart.md backed by a spec requirement, or test-only surface? [Consistency, quickstart.md]
- [ ] CHK081 Are `--gool` flag requirements consistent between contracts/cli.md and FR-009 (pair semantics)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK082 Is the scan exit-4 rule consistent between the existing scanner contract and the new seeded-scan flows? [Consistency, Spec §US-002]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK083 Can "reports which step failed and what to try next" be objectively verified (step inventory, hint inventory)? [Measurability, Spec §US-001]
- [ ] CHK084 Can "confirms whether anything actually needed replacing" be objectively verified for healthy renew? [Measurability, Spec §US-003]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK085 Are requirements defined for `register` when a healthy identity already exists (idempotent vs error)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK086 Are requirements defined for `renew` with no stored identity at all? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK087 Are requirements defined for `warp.toml` missing entirely (compiled-in fallback behavior)? [Coverage, contracts/profiles.md]
- [ ] CHK088 Are requirements defined for `warp.toml` partially valid (some sections broken)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK089 Are `--json` single-document requirements specified for all new commands? [Coverage, contracts/cli.md]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK090 Is the single-user/single-device scope reflected in CLI requirements (no multi-identity selection flags)? [Consistency, Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK091 Does inline auto-registration during `connect` conflict with `connect`'s existing no-side-effects-before-validation posture? [Conflict, Spec §FR-003]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
